name: Got Groceries Program
description: Peninsula Volunteers' Got Groceries program provides weekly bags of free groceries to individuals and families facing food insecurity, feeding about 150 families each week.
fullDescription: Peninsula Volunteers' Got Groceries program provides weekly bags of free groceries to individuals and families facing food insecurity, feeding about 150 families each week.
whatTheyOffer:
- Full bag of groceries weekly
- Fruits, vegetables, fresh perishables, proteins, and breads
- Available to individuals and families
- Pickup every Wednesday
howToGetIt: Register first using the "Register Here" form on PVI's Nutrition Services page, then pick up your groceries on Wednesdays. Call Peninsula Volunteers at 650-326-0665 for pickup location and times.
keywords: Got Groceries, Peninsula Volunteers, PVI, Menlo Park, free groceries, San Mateo County, produce, proteins, bread, weekly food
